description: Full text of ONE section of a Hong Kong law, by Cap. number or title plus section number in any common spelling — "2", "s2", "section 2", "14A". Returns the English text AND the Traditional Chinese text of that SAME section side by side — both original-language and equally authentic (Official Languages Ordinance, Cap. 5 s.4B), never one a "translation" of the other — plus the section's in-force status and version-valid-from date. A long law is never returned whole; use hk_law_toc to find section numbers, and call this once per section.

cap.description: Chapter number (from hk_law_search or hk_law_info), e.g. "486" or "486A".

title.description: English or Traditional Chinese title, used when cap is not known.

name: hk_law_section
title: Hk Law Section
